summary: Jianpu Technology Inc. (OTCQB: AIJTY) filed a Form 6-K reporting the resignation of Caofeng Liu as director, acting CEO, CTO, and COO effective June 30, 2026, for personal reasons with no disagreement. The board appointed Yisheng Gong as CEO effective July 1, 2026; Gong was previously CEO of RONG360 Inc. since November 2025 and had risk management roles at VCredit and Capital One. The change is abrupt, involving a multi-role departure, suggesting a strategic shift. Watch for further board or operational changes as the new CEO settles in.
